verdict.rationale: Yubico ships an official, scriptable ykman CLI that installs non-interactively from public registries (uvx, Homebrew) and handles device management (applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots). It also offers python-fido2 and other SDKs plus a public YubiEnterprise REST API for fleet operations, so automation from scripts and code is real. However, it is a physical device: FIDO2 operations require a user-presence touch, though the community notes touch can be turned off for most modes, so unattended headless or CI use is constrained. missing for 10: documented headless/CI usage guidance, a way to satisfy touch/user presence unattended for FIDO2, evidence of running in CI pipelines without attached hardware, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
